Tarnvale: 5,207 megalitres = 5,207,000,000 litres; per resident per day = 5,207,000,000 ÷ 71,388 ÷ 365 = 199.8 litres.

Ashgrove: 4,390,000,000 ÷ 58,760 ÷ 365 = 204.6 litres.

Difference = 204.6 − 199.8 = 4.8 litres per resident per day.

ANSWER: Ashgrove | 4.8 litres per resident per day
